hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH↔phiETH swap curve by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap: takes the input token from PoolManager, converts via phiEth deposit/withdraw, settles the output, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to no-op the concentrated liquidity pool. Direct liquidity additions are blocked, and pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiETH zero-fee pairs.
